reasoning: 16.1.3.1（PRE1.3.1）規定儲存成功時播放確認音，且 preset 按鈕以新電台資訊更新。037 拆成兩個 leaf，一為聽覺回饋、一為視覺更新，驗證標的不同。047-02 與 RAD-046-01 的差異：046 驗的是「儲存這個動作成立」，047-02 驗的是「按鈕內容確實換成新電台資訊」，故 047-02 的 ER 逐項比對頻率等資訊而非只確認槽已被佔用。容器錨定：ch16 橫跨兩個容器——Playing Tab 上的 Mixed Presets Bank（PRE1.x）與 Browse Tab 內的 Browse Presets List（PRE2.x）。兩者的 preset 外觀相近、步驟前綴卻不同，故每一行 ER 都指名觀察所在的容器，tc_title 的 tag 亦帶容器名，避免 reviewer 與測試者誤判。 兩筆皆觀察於 Playing Tab 的 Mixed Presets Bank。優先級：兩者皆為儲存操作的必要回饋，訂 P1。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 047-01 驗確認音，047-02 驗按鈕內容更新，驗證標的不同

tcs.test_item:
The system shall play a confirmation sound when a preset is successfully stored.

(Confirmation sound on storing from the Playing Tab)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot is unset
3. Touch tone sounds are enabled on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Press the preset slot displaying a plus sign "+" in the Mixed Presets Bank and listen to the audio output of the HU
4. Read the content displayed in that preset slot
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. A confirmation sound is output from the HU speakers
4. The preset slot displays the currently tuned station
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall update the preset button with the newly stored station information after preset storage is completed.

(Preset button content after storing, on the Playing Tab)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot is unset
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Record the frequency and station name of the currently tuned station shown on the Playing Tab
4. Press the preset slot displaying a plus sign "+" in the Mixed Presets Bank and read the information displayed in that slot
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The frequency and station name of the currently tuned station are recorded
4. The preset slot displays the frequency recorded in step 3, and the station name recorded in step 3 where the slot shows a station name
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
